seed: A document with a timeline shows the Library header in the dock without being asked, folded, so the media pool is one click away (video.html: the Library keeps its header, #gLibrary collapsed). One click on the header, a real click on its face with the app in front, opens the shelf with the recording on it. A picture keeps the Library out until View > Library. At Next defaults, no flag set, and nothing runs showLibrary.

steps.note: THE FIRST TEST: an eight second recording opened at Next defaults, nothing asked for. The dock ends in the LIBRARY header, folded, and no tile is drawn under it
THE SECOND TEST: one click on the Library header opens the shelf, and the recording is on it as Tutorial Sample.mp4
THE THIRD TEST: View > Library turns the shelf off in a video too, and on again
THE FOURTH TEST: a picture still keeps the Library out until View > Library, as before
